verdict.rationale: The Business & Liens portal publishes a standard credential account entry ("Sign In" / "Create an Account") with an online "Forgot your password?" recovery path. A human can complete this remotely, and nothing in the evidence points to biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN. However, the evidence never mentions MFA, so the 'credential MFA' element of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation that sign-in uses MFA (and which factors), explicit confirmation that no mailed-PIN or in-person step gates account creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sign-in flow.
